stage_name: build (architecture 2: pertussis nowcast by laboratory route)
stump: A competent solver counts the notified pertussis onsets in the last 14 days for each local government area against the protocol's expected count and sends the team to Wagga Wagga, the largest excess on file (or nowcasts with the unit's pooled reporting delay and still lands there); the step that lands it there is reading the onsets notified so far as the onsets, when Griffith's cases reach the unit through a slow private laboratory route and, at Griffith's own onset-to-notification delay, its recent onsets are several times what has arrived.

three_rules.domain: pass (epidemiological nowcast of right-truncated surveillance counts; the swap breaks it)
three_rules.analyst_test: the cases notified so far, or a nowcast on one pooled delay, send the team to Wagga Wagga; only each route's own delay finds Griffith

solver_rounds.brief: The solver ran the pooled screen, explained the co-visited plaza sites away as subsets of the pump's victims, re-screened the 78 victims the pump leaves and found the Lombard PIN pad, then checked the last 31 for a common point: 387 and every ask figure. The next rung would need a site that outranks the PIN pad on the residual and survives the subset check; any such site carries unexplained victims of its own and reads as a compromise (a fork), and any site that does not is dismissed by the subset check this solver already ran. The architecture is spent: re-root.
